paper_title: New Limit on Axion-Like Dark Matter using Cold Neutrons
notes: Paper reports oscillating neutron EDM from ALP-gluon coupling. Primary result parametrized as C_G/(f_a*m_a) in GeV^-2 (best limit 2.7e13 GeV^-2, 95% C.L., reached for ma 2e-17 to 2e-14 eV), not directly as d_n in e*cm. Mass range 1e-19 to 4e-12 eV. The plotted y-axis quantity is C_G/(f_a m_a), which does not directly map to any enum unit; AxionEDM is the closest physics match (oscillating nEDM). Data points are approximate values reconstructed from text, not from a table or readable digitized plot — coupling values shown are C_G/(f_a m_a) in GeV^-2, NOT d_n in e*cm.
